title: Integral Cohomology and Modular Decomposition for the Theta Divisor of a Cubic Threefold
description: This paper computes the integral middle lattice of the theta divisor of the intermediate Jacobian of a smooth complex cubic threefold. The lattice is free of rank 130, and its Lefschetz saturation quotient is (Z/2)^10. The Fano difference map identifies this mod-two glue and its dual escape lattice. The paper also determines the integral direct image of the blow-up resolution. Two outer point objects split over Z, while the residual perverse factor has central attachment given by multiplication by -3. After inverting three it acquires a third point summand; modulo three it is uniserial of length three, with successive factors a point sheaf, the intersection complex, and a point sheaf. The same cubic intersection number forces relative hard Lefschetz to fail modulo three. Finally, an infinite-order Fano class lifts the local order-three link class, and ordinary and intersection cohomology agree in degrees at least four.
